title: Benchmark baseline: the generator of the baseline md and csv, the independent loops and the verifier are not in the repository
body:
Found while closing the iterate-family baseline (#420, PR #429).

## What is missing

`benchmark/baselines/iterate-family-0.5.md` and `iterate-family-0.5.csv` were generated, and checked, by scripts that are not in the repository:

- a generator that turns the result directories of three repetitions, the A/A comparison of `compare.py`, the independent loops and the restore probe into the md and the csv (including the per-case A/A ratio, half-width and `gate5`);
- the independent `time_ns` loops of the cross-check (first activation at 256 and 4096 coordinates, the active sweep, `dot(v, x)`) and the restore probe;
- the check-only driver (builds the harness cases and runs every reference check without timing; see #440);
- a verifier that recomputes every csv figure and the A/A columns from the raw metrics.

The README states the rule that any edit of `benchmark/run.jl` or `benchmark/cases.jl` changes the harness hash and requires measuring the pinned source again. Doing that reproducibly, and regenerating the baseline file in the same form, needs these scripts.

## What is wanted

Add the generator, the loops and the verifier under `benchmark/` (for example `benchmark/baselines/tools/`), with one command in the README that regenerates the md and csv from the result directories, and test the generator on a small fixture in `benchmark/check_analysis.py`'s CI job. The check-only driver belongs with #440.

The scripts exist today outside the repository; the baseline's identity (harness commit `5d43d165`, `harness_hash` `844fa5330b9065ab33fc7bb9ef7605dbe8560e16`) does not depend on them.
